2123568093674766536.en_summary: I know it feels bleak out there. But giving up now is ‘selling the lows’. In last 15 years, after 6 consecutive days of decline, S&P 500 higher 1 week later (n=10), 10 of 10 times, avg gain +2.7%, median 2.1%. This is a sign of a market that is “de-risking” on compounding fears. Fears, not fundamentals. Odds of Friday being up = 70%.
2123568093674766536.zh_summary: 我知道外面感覺黢淡。但現在放棄就是「賣出低點」。過去15年，連續6天下跌後，標普500在1週後更高（n=10），10次中10次，平均收益+2.7%，中位數2.1%。這是市場在複合恐懼上「去風險」的跡象。恐懼，不是基本面。星期五上漲的概率=70%。
